name: Condenser & evaporator coils
description: Replacement heat exchanger coils for indoor and outdoor units.
long_description: Condenser coils release heat outdoors and evaporator coils absorb it indoors. Corrosion, leaks and damaged fins reduce cooling and waste power. We supply copper-tube, aluminium-fin coils matched to the original size, rows and connections for split, ductable and commercial units.
match_by: Unit model, coil dimensions and number of rows

parts.name: Condenser coils
parts.detail: Outdoor coils for split, ductable and package units.
parts.summary: Condenser coils release the heat removed from the room to outside air. We supply copper-tube, aluminium-fin coils matched to the original size, rows and connections, including coated options for coastal and polluted areas.
specs: Copper, commonly 7 mm or 9.52 mm (3/8″) OD
Matched to the original header and pipe sizes
Pressure and leak tested before dispatch
notes: Share the unit model, or the coil's length, height, rows and connection sizes
Coated fins last longer near the sea or in industrial areas

parts.name: Evaporator coils
parts.detail: Indoor cooling coils for split, cassette, ductable and AHU units.
parts.summary: Evaporator (cooling) coils absorb heat from room air inside the indoor unit. Leaks and corrosion in the coil are a common cause of repeated gas loss.
specs: Copper, commonly 7 mm or 9.52 mm (3/8″) OD
Aluminium with hydrophilic coating for drainage
DX coils for split, cassette and ductable units; chilled-water coils for AHUs and FCUs
Pressure and leak tested before dispatch
notes: Share the unit model, or the coil's size, rows and connections
Clean coils and drain pans regularly to prevent corrosion and smells

signs: Gas leaks keep coming back from the coil
Weak cooling even with the correct gas charge
